worldreroll.settings.title: Reroll settings
worldreroll.settings.description: Keep this world's settings and game rules. Choose where your new start should be.
worldreroll.settings.random_hint: Explore a new seed from its natural spawn point.
worldreroll.settings.village_hint: Start on safe ground near a village. Searching may take a while.
worldreroll.settings.structures_off: Unavailable: structure generation is turned off.
worldreroll.settings.warning: The old world is deleted only after the new start is ready. Failure keeps it.
worldreroll.confirm.village_body: Keep the settings of %s, use a new seed and start near a village. Its terrain, builds, inventory and progress will be deleted only after the new village spawn is ready. This cannot be undone.
worldreroll.locating: Finding a village and preparing safe ground…
worldreroll.tooltip: Keep world settings and start with a new seed
worldreroll.confirm.title: Start another world?
worldreroll.confirm.body: Keep the settings of %s and use a new seed. Its terrain, builds, inventory and progress will be deleted only after you enter the new world. This cannot be undone.
worldreroll.failed.title: Could not reroll world
worldreroll.failed.body: The previous world was kept. See the game log for details.
worldreroll.delete_failed: New world loaded, but cleanup of the previous world did not finish. See the game log.
worldreroll.complete: New world ready. Previous world deleted.
